name: moist_air_room_psychrometrics
title: Moist air in a room: humidity ratio, enthalpy and dew point
summary: Room of 5 m x 5 m x 3 m filled with air at 25 C and 75 % relative humidity at 100 kPa: partial pressures, humidity ratio, specific enthalpy per kg of dry air, masses of dry air and of water vapour, and dew-point temperature of the room air; every quantity is computed both with the course relations and with the EES property functions.

authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002 - see README 'Source and attribution')
origin.course: ULiège Thermodynamique appliquée (MECA0002), exercise session R9 (2022-2023), exercise 1

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file R09_E01_2022.EES (EES 10.836) and, as a second reference, the Python/CoolProp solution of the same exercise shipped with the course (2021 edition, ThAp21_R08E01.py)
verification.notes: Hand-converted from kPa/kJ. compare_solution.py --ees-units: 27 common variables, 7 above rtol 1e-3, largest relative deviation 4.76e-03 (m_v, following the EES HumRat function: CoolProp humid air carries the water-enhancement factor, so w_ees is 0.42 % above the course formula w_corr, itself within 3.4e-05 of EES); h_a 3.2e-03 (EES moist-air enthalpy reference/formulation), h_air3 1.8e-03 and v/m_air 3.1e-04 (EES ideal-gas Air vs CoolProp Air), T_r 3.4e-03 (dew point from w_corr instead of from phi). R_air and R_v are reported as differing by 9.99e-01 only because the tool does not convert the lowercase EES unit spelling kj/(kg-C) (new tool bug CS-BUG-COMPARE-UNIT-CASE): 0.28705 kJ/(kg-K) and 287.05 J/(kg-K) are the same value. The 31 variables of the EES file that are not in the model are the stale leftovers of an earlier exercise of the same file (h[1..6], p[1..6], T[1..6], s[1..6], v[1..6], t[5], h, a, R). Second reference: p_air, w_corr, h_a and m_air agree with the Python/CoolProp solution of the course to 4e-10 or better.
